description: Q4T private extension, not an OpenAI or vLLM endpoint compatibility claim.

oneOf.description: Optional for historical v1 records; emitted by the media admission implementation. Logical source/decoder/workspace limits do not reserve physical RAM.
Native media v2 includes temporal grouping and actual execution constraints.

max_inflight_requests.description: Requested auto sentinel 0; effective value derived after startup budget. Request count, not RAM or connection reservation.

max_queued_requests.description: Requested auto sentinel -1; effective value derived after startup budget. Request count, not RAM or connection reservation.

client_policy.description: Immutable startup binding. The v3 snapshot is not the currently applied policy; see current_client_policy.

application_state.description: Present when the native application object store is implemented; absent in historical config-v1 records.

responses_background.description: Present when native background Responses is implemented; current runtime recovery state, independent of model readiness.

cache_io.description: Native optional cache worker observations. Omitted in historical config-v1 records; all buffers and worker memory use unified RAM. Buffer cap excludes process/library metadata overhead. Observed RSS is the last reported maximum, zero is unknown when worker_rss_known is false.

current_client_policy.description: Current atomic model policy, distinct from the startup binding; publisher loss does not erase an installed policy. No credential values are exposed.
